snippet.title: LTX 2.3 is a New Free and Open Source AI Video Model that can generatre 4k Qaultity AI Videos
snippet.description:
You don't need to pay for Veo 3, Kling, or Sora anymore.

I recently tried this new open-source tool called LTX 2.3. It lets you make 4K videos right on your computer. For free. No subscriptions.

Think of it like this: You type a description. Or upload a picture. LTX turns it into a full video. With clear 4K quality. Plus sound. Music. Effects. All synced up perfectly.

The good news? They also released LTX Desktop. It's a free editor. You download the models once. Then work offline. Depending on your computer's power, of course.

Here's what you can do in it:

• 1. Add your videos to a project.
• 2. Cut out bad scenes. Swap in new ones.
• 3. Drop in text. Mix in music.
• 4. Edit everything in one spot.

I tested it last week. Asked it to make a short clip of a mountain hike. From a simple text prompt. The result? Looked like a movie trailer. Took two minutes on my laptop.

No cloud needed. Your files stay private. Like cooking in your own kitchen. No one peeks.

Want smooth results? Use a decent graphics card. But it works on regular setups too.

Even better. Anyone can grab it from their open-source repo. Install and start creating.

snippet.title: You can now vibe-code full mobile apps using Google's new free feature inside AI Studio
snippet.description:
Google just launched a free AI coding tool that lets you vibe-code full mobile apps without writing a single line of code.

It's a brand new feature inside AI Studio.

And it might be the fastest way to ship an Android app right now.

To use it, first click on the button called Build An Android App.

That's the entry point for the whole workflow.

Then just describe your app idea in plain English. Fitness tracker, budgeting app, plant care reminder, whatever you have in mind.

The Antigravity agent takes it from there. It builds the entire app for you in minutes, not weeks.

Think of it like having a full mobile dev team on standby.

You describe, they build, you ship.

Plus, it has access to all of Google's other AI tools baked in.

So you can use Nano Banana to create custom assets, or pull your screen designs directly from Stitch.

No jumping between platforms. No copy-pasting between five different tools. Everything lives inside one flow.

Once your app is ready, you have two ways to launch it.

Install it directly on your Android phone for testing, or publish it straight to the Play Store in just a few clicks.

That last part is huge. Most no-code app builders stop at the prototype stage.

This one takes you all the way to production.

For indie hackers, solo founders, and anyone with an app idea sitting in their notes, this changes the entire barrier to shipping.

#Googleai #googleaistudio #mobileappdev #aicoding #vibecoding

Claude Fable reasons on every request, so the old habit of scripting every step quietly caps the smartest model on Earth at your own level. → Set boundaries. The stop line and go line that keep Fable from remodeling the whole house when you only asked it to fix one thing.

So your setup keeps getting smarter without you doing anything. That last part is wild.

Most tools stay static after install. This one evolves with you.

Together these five turn Claude Code from a coding assistant into a full senior dev partner.

Faster, sharper, and tailored to how you actually build.
